content: लङ्का [लक्-अच् मुम् च] .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of the capital and residence of Rāvaṇa and identified with the island of Ceylon or the chief town in it; according to some Laṅkā was much larger than the present island of Ceylon. It was originally built for Mālyavat <ab>q. v.</ab>; विजेतव्या लङ्का चरणतरणीयो जलनिधिः <ls>Udb.</ls> .²2 An unchaste woman, a prostitute, harlot. .²3 A branch. .²4 A kind of grain. (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>लांक</ns>).
